_note: Protocol = the paper's R code 1:1 (see the YAML header): measured 2026-08-25 on the feat/followups branch. Paper Sec. 5.1-5.2. The interventional means are analytic (E[x3|do(x2=a)] = -0.25 + 0.25a), so what is checked is the flow's error against them, not a pinned flow value: a center plus an error bound on the same number gave two windows that could disagree. do(x2=-3) is off-manifold extrapolation, which is why its error is the largest of the three.
